fonts.display: 'bureauSerif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, heading strokes, card borders, filled CTA backgrounds — the sole carrier of visual weight in an otherwise empty palette

palette.name: Paper Cream
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, and the default background — warm off-white that distinguishes the brand from clinical SaaS whites

palette.name: Warm Border
palette.role: Elevated surface, hairline dividers, and card-on-card separation — one shade deeper than the canvas to create structure without contrast

palette.name: Stone Gray
palette.role: Secondary body text, muted labels, subtle borders — never used for primary copy

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Tertiary text, helper copy, disabled states — the quietest voice in the type stack

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Text on dark filled CTAs, occasional card surface where higher contrast is needed against the cream canvas
